description: Shows every Codex session the current roadmap slice and item (scripts/cycle.ts). Codex runs these only after they are trusted in /hooks; and runs the done gate (scripts/done-gate.ts) when a turn ends.

hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/done-gate.ts"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec "$(command -v bun || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")" "$f" hook codex
f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/done-gate.ts"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec "$(command -v bun || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")" "$f" hook codex
